summary: Resolves a text attribute from a list node and copies it into the caller's output struct (a1). Uses LinkedListIndexedAccessor_5680(a3) to fetch the indexed node, dispatches on the attribute mode a2 (0 selects node+52 or node+72, 1 selects node+132 or node+152, the a4 flag selecting the alternate slot), copies the selected string through StringCopyWithBufferRealloc with an empty-sentinel fallback (byte_5EA438), then copies the node attribute dword/byte components into a1+8/a1+12/a1+16. Ends by re-copying the empty sentinel and returning -1 when the output struct is still the all-empty sentinel, else 1. Called by SessionStringNameLookup (004122C0).

local_names.a1: output struct receiving the attribute string and components (this+0/8/C/10)
local_names.a3: list index passed to the indexed accessor
local_names.a4: slot-select flag choosing the alternate attribute slot
local_names.v4: indexed list node returned by LinkedListIndexedAccessor_5680
local_names.v5: selected attribute slot within the node
local_names.v6: string pointer of the selected attribute slot

operations.description: LinkedListIndexedAccessor_5680(a3) resolves the indexed list node; when it returns null the attribute-copy block is skipped entirely

Attribute-mode dispatch on a2: a2==0 selects node+52 (or node+72 when a4 is clear), a2==1 selects node+132 (or node+152 when a4 is clear), and any other a2 value falls through to the default empty path
The selected attribute string is copied via StringCopyWithBufferRealloc, substituting the empty sentinel byte_5EA438 when the node string pointer is null
Copies the attribute components from the selected node slot (dword at +8, dword at +12, byte at +16) into the output struct at a1+8, a1+12 and a1+16
Unconditionally re-copies the empty sentinel byte_5EA438 through StringCopyWithBufferRealloc to reset the working string buffer
Empty-result check: the output string (a1+0, falling back to the empty sentinel when null) equals byte_5EA438 AND a1+8 equals -1 AND a1+12 equals -1 AND the byte at a1+16 is zero
Returns -1 when the all-empty sentinel is detected, otherwise 1
Invoked by SessionStringNameLookup (004122C0) while resolving a session string name
